# `mcp-scaffold migrate`

- **Usage**: `mcp-scaffold migrate [FLAGS] <id>`

Run a single migration or one whole phase

## Arguments

### `<id>`

e.g. 06-mcp-kit/m1-mcp-kit, or just 06-mcp-kit

## Flags

### `--target <dir>`

Path to target repo

### `--mode <mode>`

'new' or 'existing' (default: existing)

**Choices:**

- `new`
- `existing`

### `--execute`

Actually apply (default is dry-run)

### `--force`

Overwrite divergent files (default: preserve in existing mode)

### `--report-json <path>`

Write a machine-readable migration report

### `--name <name>`

Tool name (kebab-case, BARE — no -mcp suffix)

### `--scope <scope>`

Npm scope, with leading @

### `--package-manager <pm>`

pnpm | npm | bun (fresh scaffolds require pnpm; existing repos auto-detect)

**Choices:**

- `pnpm`
- `npm`
- `bun`

### `--no-tui`

Skip the Ink/React TUI surface

### `--no-install`

Skip the package-manager install after dependencies change

### `--no-http`

Skip the Streamable HTTP transport

### `--no-rust-accel`

Skip the optional Rust acceleration crate

### `--no-semantic-release`

Skip the semantic-release workflow

### `--cli-bin <name>`

Bin name for the standalone usage(1) artifacts pipeline (08-app/m2-cli-artifacts)

### `--cli-dir <dir>`

Repo-relative directory receiving the usage(1) artifacts pipeline (default: .)
